recognize_zh: 較高倍骨髓抹片中多顆大型組織球，細胞質內充滿大小一致的圓形透明空泡（肥皂泡樣），其中一顆另含棕褐色與藍綠色顆粒狀色素，核小而偏位，符合泡沫狀／含色素組織球的骨髓組織球增多。
features: Several large histiocytes with cytoplasm distended by uniform round clear vacuoles (soap-bubble foam cells)
Upper-left histiocyte with coarse golden-brown pigment and fine blue-green granules among the vacuoles
Small round eccentric nuclei with condensed chromatin
Adjacent erythroid precursors, myelocytes and small lymphocytes appear unremarkable
No engulfed intact blood cells or organisms identified
describe_en: Higher-power view of a bone marrow aspirate shows several large histiocytes whose cytoplasm is distended by uniform clear round vacuoles, with small eccentric nuclei. One histiocyte additionally contains coarse golden-brown pigment and fine blue-green granules, consistent with hemosiderin and ceroid. The surrounding erythroid, granulocytic and lymphoid cells appear unremarkable, and no hemophagocytosis or organisms are seen. Findings are consistent with marrow histiocytosis with foamy, lipid- and pigment-laden histiocytes; storage disorders (e.g., Niemann-Pick) and secondary causes should be evaluated clinically and biochemically.

ddx.vs: Niemann-Pick foam cells look identical, so diagnosis requires acid sphingomyelinase assay or NPC gene testing.
Sea-blue histiocytes are dominated by blue-green granular ceroid rather than clear lipid vacuoles.
Gaucher cells have fibrillary crumpled cytoplasm without discrete clear vacuoles.
Hemophagocytic histiocytes contain recognizable engulfed red cells, neutrophils or nucleated cells instead of vacuoles.
